# Structure fixtures

Explicitly authored synthetic `document` mappings that pin the T-02/T-03
structure-evidence behavior: text and table TOCs, multi-page continuation, split
title/page paragraphs, repeated titles, printed/physical page mismatch, dotted
levels, absent/partial TOCs and numeric data-table negatives.

Input/output: read-only JSON, loaded by `tests/support/structure_fixtures.py`
(`load`) and regenerated by its `write_all_fixtures()`.

Dependencies: consumed by `tests/phase1/test_structure_evidence.py`.

Check: `python -m unittest tests.phase1.test_structure_evidence`.
